alerts.title: Acute Kidney Injury
alerts.message: Guidelines state TDF can cause chronic kidney disease and acute kidney injury. Patient's creatinine level increased from 0.9 to 2.4, indicating acute kidney injury. Dehydration from gastroenteritis may also contribute to kidney injury. TDF may be a contributing factor, but non-drug causes like dehydration should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor kidney function and consider alternative regimens
